corrections.issue: The sandbox denies /proc child executable access after PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0.
corrections.resolution: Keep the exact child pidfd and arguments; report an unavailable executable hash rather than fabricating one. Held cases verify the parent-held immutable ELF digest and four seals against the relocated package. This relies on the separately qualified sealed-launch contract, not privileged child inspection.

corrections.issue: A process can exit between reading cmdline and resolving exe; an empty cmdline then triggered the live-image assertion.
corrections.resolution: Observe the already-open pidfd. If it reports exit, record exited-before-executable-observation; do not claim a digest or a live image identity.

corrections.issue: The Keys observer only discovers the Settings-titled window.
corrections.resolution: Acquire the independent XTest handle while Settings is displayed; retain the native window identity through navigation to inspection.

corrections.issue: The default small-fixture observer waits only twelve seconds for a saved profile.
corrections.resolution: Use the existing 60000-ms total transfer deadline from w-08-profile-projection with two seconds for observation. Each case allows two transfers plus teardown. No product transfer/image/erasure deadline changed.

corrections.issue: The exploratory topology-probe-e38f3786 criterion_met field only checked geometry although the criterion text also named notifications.
corrections.resolution: Preserve as geometry-only evidence. The subsequent topology-probe-5e06af05 independently observed 800/400/800 geometry plus monitor-added and monitor-removed, satisfying the full experiment criterion.
